_comment: GENERATED by camfrog-bot tools/build_owner_caps.py from Pepe's code - don't edit by hand.

capabilities.title: Run your room's stage
capabilities.howto: Type !stage in your Camfrog room to see what's on. Feature an open slot to make it the room's main stream (free), unfeature it, cut a slot (the unused PAT is refunded) or set how many user slots the room has. The same controls are on the Stage tab of your pad settings.

capabilities.title: Switch cam snapshots on or off
capabilities.howto: !snap lets people save a still of someone's cam (they pay the snap price). Type !snap off in your room to stop it there, or flip it on your owner page.

capabilities.title: Switch cam clips on or off
capabilities.howto: !clip records a few seconds of a cam to a link (and the website's 🎬 Clip). Switch it per room in chat or on your owner page.

capabilities.title: Run your room's soundboard
capabilities.howto: Prime Time pads get a soundboard of their own (8 clips, Prime Time Plus 24): lines Pepe says in a voice you pick, or someone's mic clip (unless they opted out - they earn a cut of every paid play). You set each clip's price and your pad gets 20% of every paid play. !sb off (or the Soundboard switch on your owner page) switches plays off in your room - Pepe refuses them politely and charges nothing (!say isn't affected).

capabilities.title: Pick Pepe's language in your room
capabilities.howto: Pepe follows the room's chat language by default (auto). Fix it to one language with !language es (or pick it on your owner page); !language auto goes back to following the chat.

capabilities.title: Set your room's vibe
capabilities.howto: Pepe learns how your room talks and matches it. Set the type yourself (chill, fight, flirty...), how hard he roasts, add notes he should know, or lock the vibe so he stops relearning it. !roomvibe on its own shows it.

capabilities.title: See what Pepe knows about your room
capabilities.howto: Shows the topics, running jokes and regulars Pepe has picked up in your room. refresh relearns them, forget wipes them, and site on|off sends the room's analytics to your pad page.

capabilities.title: Switch mic challenges on or off
capabilities.howto: Mic challenges (sing, laugh, beatbox...) are judged by Pepe and paid from your pad vault. Turn them off in your room with !challenge off, or on your owner page.

capabilities.title: Start, open and close mic challenges
capabilities.howto: As the owner you can start a challenge for someone (!challenge sing @bob), open a round anyone can enter (!challenge open sing 2m), close the round or cancel a challenge.

capabilities.title: Cancel someone's duel or brawl challenge
capabilities.howto: Anyone can cancel their own challenge; in your room you can also cancel other people's open duel or brawl challenges (their stakes are refunded).

capabilities.title: Get your vault deposits matched (launch pads)
capabilities.howto: While your pad is new (a launch pad), what you deposit into its pad vault is matched from the launchpad budget up to its cap. Deposit with !padvault deposit <amount> or the Top up form on your owner page.

capabilities.title: Change your room's Pepe settings from the website
capabilities.howto: The 🐸 Pepe card at the top of your owner page shows what Pepe is really doing in your room right now (with when he last reported it) and changes it: snapshots, clips, mic challenges, the soundboard, Pepe's language and everything below. They're the same settings the chat commands and Pepe's admins use, so chat, the admin panel and the page always agree, and a switch shows 'waiting for Pepe' until he confirms it.

capabilities.title: Choose what Pepe does in your room
capabilities.howto: Switch Pepe's welcome-back greetings on or off (and leave him a note about what to mention), set how chatty he is (off, low, normal, high), allow music and the DJ, song requests, !say, picking a voice (-v) and spoken (-mic) replies in your room.

capabilities.title: Choose which games run in your room
capabilities.howto: Allow or stop trivia, pictionary, heists, the wheel, bingo, duels and brawls (with the arena and showdowns) and the casino tables (Hold'em and blackjack) in your room. Turf wars and the casino backend stay with Pepe's admins.

capabilities.title: Set how Pepe moderates your room
capabilities.howto: Global unblock (Pepe undoes mic blocks other people make in your room; his own stay), mic-hog policing, how many strikes someone gets before Pepe acts (inside the range Pepe's admins allow, 2-5 by default) and whether people can start community votes (!votekick, !voteblock, !votemod, !timeout).

capabilities.title: Pick Pepe's voice in your room
capabilities.howto: Choose the voice Pepe speaks in by default in your room: one of the voices you own (bought in the voice store, or your own approved clone) or Pepe's default. If you lose the voice (a refund, a revoked clone, a takedown) the room goes back to Pepe's default by itself. Someone's own -v voice on !say still wins, and Pepe's lines in your room's voice never cost anyone a per-use price.

capabilities.title: Let Pepe start conversations when the room goes quiet
capabilities.howto: Conversation starters: when your room has been quiet for a while (5 to 240 minutes, you pick) with people still around, Pepe throws out a question or a topic - once per quiet spell. While the Auto-DJ plays here, the DJ opens the topic between songs instead.

capabilities.title: Captions, alerts and DJ drops in your room
capabilities.howto: Show a 🔊 caption of what Pepe says on the mic, let event alerts (heists, games and drops elsewhere) reach your room, and allow the DJ's short spoken drops between songs - each only in your room.

capabilities.title: Pick your room's vibe on the website
capabilities.howto: The same as !roomvibe: the room type (chill, fight, music...), how Pepe treats roasts, and the lock that stops him relearning it.

capabilities.title: Set your room's topic
capabilities.howto: In your own pad's chat room !topic is free for you (everyone else pays for it), or type the topic on your owner page. Up to 200 characters and 6 changes an hour; slurs, threats, phone numbers and addresses are refused, and so is anything that looks like a pad code (PATV-...): those go in the topic only by the room's owner typing it there. A pad code that's in the topic while a connection waits for it stays in the topic. Your topic pauses Pepe's auto-topic for 6 hours (switch the auto-topic on again to resume it sooner).

capabilities.title: Set your room's topic from the website
capabilities.howto: The topic box on your owner page: Pepe sets it in your connected room with the same checks and limits as !topic, and the page shows the room's topic as Pepe last saw it.

capabilities.title: Let Pepe keep your room's topic fresh
capabilities.howto: The auto-topic: Pepe writes a new one-line topic about what your room is talking about. Switch it on or off and pick how often (every 15 minutes to every 3 hours) - never more often than Pepe's admins allow, and only while their master switch is on. Until you choose, your room follows Pepe's default.

capabilities.title: Pick the language Pepe transcribes your room's mic in
capabilities.howto: Pepe transcribes mic-ups (for the pad's mic transcripts, captions and what he knows was said). By default your room follows Pepe's setting; pick auto (Pepe detects the language of every clip) or one fixed language for a room that speaks it. Someone with their own transcription language set by Pepe's admins keeps it. This is the transcription only - the language Pepe answers in is the Language setting.

capabilities.title: Connect your room to its pad page
capabilities.howto: Choose what your pad's web page carries from the Camfrog room: website chat lines, push-to-talk voice clips, cam snapshots, room audio and mic transcripts.

capabilities.title: Moderate people in your room
capabilities.howto: In your own pad's room Pepe kicks, bans, punishes and mic-blocks for you (and lifts them). Type it in the room or use Moderate your room on the owner page - it lists who's in the room and who is banned or blocked, with undo. Pepe's admins and owners (and Pepe) are off limits.

capabilities.title: Give people room roles
capabilities.howto: Make someone a moderator, admin or friend of your room, or take their role off - Pepe changes the room's oplist for you. Your own room only, never Pepe's admins or owners; every change asks first on the website and goes in your pad's event log.

capabilities.title: Time someone out
capabilities.howto: In your room your !timeout works straight away (up to 24 hours) instead of starting a vote: Pepe mutes them in your pad's room only - not in other rooms, and their red list and roles aren't touched. It lifts itself when the time is up, survives a Pepe restart, and shows as timed out in Moderate your room's Banned & punished list with undo (or type !untimeout). A Pepe time-out from an admin stays as it is.

capabilities.title: Fine someone
capabilities.howto: Fine someone in your room up to 100,000 PAT at a time; it goes into the Federal Reserve and Pepe says it in the room.

capabilities.title: Bring Pepe in, send him out, or rejoin
capabilities.howto: 💎 Prime Time Plus pads: the owner page shows whether Pepe is in your room (or joining / recovering) and lets you ask him in, out or to rejoin - one action every 2 minutes. He stays out until you ask him back; he's in at most 5 rooms at a time and never leaves his own.

capabilities.title: Top up your pad vault from the website
capabilities.howto: The Top up form on the owner page deposits PAT from your linked Camfrog name (or your PATV account if you haven't linked one) into the pad vault (minimum 1,000). It's exactly !padvault deposit: deposits never count as the pad's income, and a double click is one deposit.

admin_only: Pepe's voice on the mic (!speak, TTS)
the casino backend for the room (!casino backend)
automod rules (!automod) and the anti-abuse switch
the soundboard master switch and the strike range owners pick from
Pepe's persona and costume (one Pepe for every room)
the auto-topic's master switch and the shortest auto-topic interval owners may pick
the mic slots and the transcriber's global rules (auto-detect allow-list, per-person languages)
